nodes.label: AssetManager
nodes.summary: Centralized asset loader with caching and priority‑based preloading.

nodes.label: CacheManager
nodes.summary: Central cache for assets and in-flight loads used by {@link AssetManager}.

nodes.label: GLTFAssetLoader
nodes.summary: GLTF loader with DRACO/KTX2 support, de-duplication, and caching.

nodes.label: AudioSystem
nodes.summary: Runtime audio manager that loads sources, pools players, and applies XR-aware behavior.

nodes.label: CameraSystem
nodes.summary: CameraSystem - Manages camera stream lifecycle for CameraSource components Automatically starts streams when the world is visible, including browser non-immersive mode and immersive XR sessions.

nodes.label: DepthSensingSystem
nodes.summary: DepthSensingSystem - Manages WebXR depth sensing and occlusion.

nodes.label: World
nodes.summary: World is the root ECS container, Three.js scene/renderer owner, and XR session gateway.

nodes.label: EnvironmentRaycastSystem
nodes.summary: System that manages environment raycasting.

nodes.label: EnvironmentSystem
nodes.summary: Unified background and image‑based lighting system.

nodes.label: GrabSystem
nodes.summary: Manages interactive object grabbing and manipulation for VR/AR experiences.

nodes.label: InputSystem
nodes.summary: Samples XR poses (hands/controllers/head) and gamepads, curates the set of interactables for pointer raycasting, and attaches minimal event listeners.

nodes.label: XRLayerSystem
nodes.summary: XRLayerSystem manages WebXR quad and cylinder composition layers. For each entity with an {@link XRQuadLayer} or {@link XRCylinderLayer} component, the system: - Creates a mesh (plane or cylinder) as a child of the entity's object3D - Renders layer content via the component's `renderCallback` while…

nodes.label: SceneJSONImporter
nodes.summary: Loads native IWSDK scene JSON documents into a level root.

nodes.label: LevelSystem
nodes.summary: Manages the active level root, enforces identity transforms, and atomically loads levels.

nodes.label: ActionLocomotionInputProvider
nodes.summary: Converts low-level input actions into locomotion intent. Locomotion should not care whether input came from XR controllers, keyboard, browser gamepads, or an app-authored adapter. This provider is the narrow bridge between generic actions and the existing locomotor systems.

nodes.label: LocomotionSystem
nodes.summary: Physics‑driven locomotion (slide, teleport, turn) backed by the {@link @iwsdk/locomotor!Locomotor} engine.

nodes.label: SlideSystem
nodes.summary: Analog stick sliding locomotion with optional comfort vignette and jump.

nodes.label: TeleportSystem
nodes.summary: Arc‑based teleportation with surface validation and hand/controller input.

nodes.label: TurnSystem
nodes.summary: Player yaw rotation via snap or smooth turning.

nodes.label: PhysicsSystem
nodes.summary: Manages a Havok simulation on either a dedicated worker or the main thread. Per-frame commands and poses travel through a pair of transferable ArrayBuffers. Both execution modes use the same binary protocol and shared Havok runtime. Worker mode alternates ownership of transferable ArrayBuffers, avo…

nodes.label: SceneUnderstandingSystem
nodes.summary: Manages WebXR scene understanding features including plane detection, mesh detection, and anchoring.

nodes.label: UIKitDocument
nodes.summary: Lightweight DOM-like wrapper around a UIKit root `Component` that lives in the 3D scene.

nodes.label: PanelUISystem
nodes.summary: Renders and updates spatial UI panels.

nodes.label: Locomotor
nodes.summary: Main thread interface for locomotion physics engine Supports both web worker mode (default) and inline mode - Worker mode: Runs physics engine in a separate thread for better performance - Inline mode: Runs physics engine in the same thread for snappier controls Use LocomotorConfig.useWorker to con…

nodes.label: GazePointer
nodes.summary: Singleton gaze pointer. Peer of {@link MultiPointer} in {@link XRInputManager}.

nodes.label: MultiPointer
nodes.summary: MultiPointer orchestrates multiple pointer types using priority-based selection.

nodes.label: Assets and levels
nodes.summary: Cached loaders for models, textures, and audio plus atomic level loading from scene JSON.

nodes.label: Environment and senses
nodes.summary: Backgrounds, lighting, spatial audio, depth occlusion, and real-world plane and mesh detection.

nodes.label: Grab and gaze interaction
nodes.summary: Turns pointer hits into grabbing, manipulation, and gaze wiring for interactables.

nodes.label: Input and pointers
nodes.summary: Samples hands, controllers, gamepads, and gaze into prioritized pointers for raycasting.

nodes.label: Movement and physics
nodes.summary: Slide, teleport, turn, and Havok simulation backed by the locomotor engine.

nodes.label: UI and display layers
nodes.summary: Spatial UIKit panels, XR composition layers, and animated hand and controller visuals.

nodes.label: World and startup
nodes.summary: World owns the scene, renderer, and XR session; systems tick each frame and startup adopts sessions.

nodes.label: loadCachedAsset
nodes.summary: Run one cache-backed load with request de-duplication and a finite timeout. Late callbacks are ignored after timeout and cannot publish into the cache. A loader may provide `discard` to release resources created by such a late callback. Replaced requests still settle for their original callers, but…

nodes.label: createSystem
nodes.summary: Create a strongly-typed System class with query bindings and reactive config.

nodes.label: armSessionGrantCapture
nodes.summary: Start recording native sessiongranted events before asynchronous world initialization begins. Calling this more than once for the same XRSystem is a no-op.

nodes.label: armSessionGrantCaptureForOptions
nodes.summary: Arm capture synchronously when world options request grant-driven launch.

nodes.label: adoptXRSession
nodes.summary: Adopt a native or emulated session into the world's renderer. Concurrent offer/request paths reconcile here: the first successfully adopted session wins and any later session is ended.

nodes.label: launchXR
nodes.summary: Explicitly request a WebXR session with the given options.

nodes.label: disposeScenePrimitiveObject
nodes.summary: Dispose only the resources owned directly by a scene primitive mesh.

lessons.title: Explode a real SDK
objectives: See a large open source codebase through its most relevant parts.
Tell what an AI chose from what the source proves.

steps.caption: This is Meta's Immersive Web SDK, the open source framework this app runs on (meta/immersive-web-sdk, MIT). Its source was indexed: 195 files, 1273 declarations.
Nobody can read 1273 parts at once. Press Explode to see the 46 that matter most, in 7 groups.
steps.hint: Press Explode. You can also pinch with both hands and pull them apart.

steps.caption: The 7 glowing groups were chosen by an AI model (muse-spark-1.3) from a digest of the index, so each is marked a hypothesis. The parts inside were ranked from the call graph and come straight from the source.
Follow one real chain of calls. Press Trace a move.
steps.hint: The Trace button is in the panel next to you.

steps.caption: Each of the 6 steps is a call found in the source. Select one and open its evidence to see the lines.
steps.hint: Select any part, then press Evidence.

steps.caption: That is 46 of 508 classes and functions. Nothing here was run, so nothing is marked observed, and no connection can be unplugged. Explore freely.
